It is not a creature spell, so it does not trigger Chulane, and it is not an engine piece, but it is cheap interaction in the third colour. It is weaker than exile removal because the creature stays and the Aura can be removed or the creature bounced.

notes.E: 1 mana turns any creature into a 1/1 with no abilities.
notes.F: Non-creature removal: no cast trigger, no land or bounce link.
notes.T: Answers one opponent's creature or commander ability; leaves a 1/1 body.
notes.R: Good whenever an opponent has a threatening creature; dead against few creatures.
notes.K: One-shot effect, nothing to repeat.
notes.D: One blue pip, no sweeper or symmetry cost; Aura can be undone by bounce.
notes.H: Cheap flexible removal that is not exile, so solid filler.

reason: A 7-mana 5/7 reach creature whose cast trigger exiles an artifact, enchantment or land, and which can return from the graveyard to hand for {2}{C} and a sacrificed land.
